title: Work as a view
summary: Issues, pull requests, proposals, runs, threads and deploys become nodes on a map of their own, the Work view beside Map and Flow, with edges to each other and to the code they touch. The server works the graph out in one request. The side panel goes; its lists stay as the Work list, a piece of their own.

add.label: work-graph.js
add.desc: The map of work in one answer: issues, PRs, proposals, runs, threads and deploys as nodes, their links to each other and to the code they touch. A PR's files are read once per head and kept.

add.label: work-view.js
add.desc: The Work view: lanes by stage (talk, decide, build, ship) and the code the work touches, laid out as the House view is.

add.label: work-list.js
add.desc: The Work list: the lists the Work panel's tabs held, as a piece of their own. A row selects its node in the Work view.
